rationale: Georgi is building AI-agent automation for GTM workflows at an early stage when startups need to do more with less, and Yuichiro's deep expertise in computational chemistry and materials informatics—plus his patent work on advanced materials—could unlock novel use cases in materials-science-focused startups that need GTM automation. While their domains differ, Georgi's hands-on conviction that automation lets small teams punch above their weight aligns with the kind of technical depth Yuichiro brings, and Georgi actively judges builder events and hires execution-focused talent, making this a natural opportunity to explore how researcher-founder collaboration might surface new problem spaces.
intro_message: Yuichiro, meet Georgi — he's building AI-agent GTM automation for startups and actively scouts technical talent and novel use cases at builder events; your materials informatics and polymer research background could help him identify underserved verticals where automation matters most.
